question_text: The Declaration of Policy in Section 2 of RA 6713 states that 'public office is a public trust.' Which of the following scenarios BEST exemplifies this principle?

options.text: A mayor uses his position to secure a government loan for his family's business.
A barangay captain prioritizes the repair of a bridge that serves the majority of residents over a road leading to a private subdivision.
A congressman hires his wife as his chief of staff at a salary higher than the standard rate.
A government employee accepts a gift from a supplier in exchange for faster processing of permits.
